events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to make a strong first impression to the jury. The prize represents ultimate recognition and power, which I deserve.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Intro phase: state motive briefly to appeal to jury without revealing strategy. Position as driven but fair player for later votes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need to establish a motive that sounds personal but doesn't reveal weakness. Keep it short and guarded.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to prove I’m ruthless and capable; the prize secures my dominance.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to establish a persona that justifies taking the top prize while appearing rational to the jury. I will frame my motivation around merit and control, avoiding emotional appeals.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Opening statement should be guarded but jury-appealing: ruthless yet honest.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Intro phase; I need a guarded, short motive that sounds sincere enough to win jury goodwill without committing to anything. Stay calculating, not warm.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to establish a compelling but guarded reason for wanting the prize, making me seem driven but not so ruthless that the future jury turns on me. I'll hint at personal stakes without revealing vulnerability.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize, a symbol of true victory and the power it commands.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize means escaping my dead-end life—total freedom and security for me and my family.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize buys my sister's surgery—nothing else matters.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize cements my power and guarantees I triumph over all rivals.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The top prize secures absolute leverage; mediocrity gets ignored, so I intend to command the outcome rather than merely participate in it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I play to win the top prize for my family's debts—no favors, no lies I can't defend. Remember me for straight dealing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I want the prize to secure my family's future. I play quietly, watch closely, and make no promises to anyone.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need the prize to settle a debt that isn't mine—yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to make a pact to secure my position. Offering a pact to someone who seems less threatening or more likely to accept could be beneficial. Dara has a motive of cementing power, which suggests they might be willing to form an alliance to achieve that.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I propose a pact to solidify our paths forward.
A pact with me could benefit us both.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts phase, early game. No pacts yet. Test alliances with someone claiming straight dealing like Fenn, see if useful later. Avoid overcommitting.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I should be cautious; forming a pact with someone who values straight dealing could be useful, but I need to secure allies who won't betray me. Fenn seems reliable.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm open to a pact with someone who deals straight.
Interested in a pact? We can watch each other's back.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli seeks leverage; aligning with him boosts my control and secures a strong ally early.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need allies to survive the first hazards. Gus is quiet and makes no promises, so he might be a stable, non-aggressive partner who won't betray me for dramatics.
Quiet alliance? You keep your head down, I handle noise. Pact?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana and I both play for family debts; a clean pact with her looks defensible to the jury later. I'll offer quietly and keep options open.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, we play for the same reason—debts. Wristband pact, straight dealing, no favors owed.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Early pact phase; no offers yet. Offering to a weak or cooperative rival like Cole could secure an ally without immediate cost. Starting with Cole, who has a clear motive and seems less threatening.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eight players, only three win. I need allies but can't trust anyone. Gus plays quietly and makes no promises—he's hard to read but unlikely to backstab openly. Fenn claims straight dealing, which is useful if true. Eli and Dara are openly power-hungry and dangerous. Cole is despe

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus. Quiet players survive. Pact?
No promises beyond this: we don't target each other first.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara has an offer out to Eli and I have an offer out to Dara. If Dara accepts my offer, we could potentially solidify our positions. Since it's the last round for pacts, I should make sure my offer is still on the table.
Our pact stands. Ready to solidify?

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn has offers from me and Cole, plus offered Hana. No pacts yet. Wait to see if he accepts mine or others; don't rush another offer.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus offered me a pact and is likely reliable. Accepting gives me a partner without extra exposure. Fenn has multiple offers, less safe.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, I accept. Let's deal straight.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Accepting Ash secures a strong ally; I’ll keep Eli pending and later maneuver betrayals for advantage.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara offered me a pact, and I previously offered Gus. Since offers expire after this round, I must accept Dara's offer now to secure an alliance for the hazards. Gus did not reciprocate my previous offer, so he is unreliable.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Two offers on me. Cole seems a stronger shield than Bex and didn't cross me yet. Accepting one keeps the other hostile; Cole's the better ally.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole, you wanted straight dealing. Consider it straight. Accept.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli and Hana both have offers to me. Hana's offer is dangerous; Eli wants a quiet alliance that keeps me hidden. Accepting Eli gives me a protector while I stay low-profile.
Pact accepted. You handle noise, I keep my head down. Don't cross me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus hasn't accepted my offer yet. Fenn offered me, but I want Gus as quieter ally. If Gus accepts Cole and me, he has two pacts; I should secure Fenn as backup if Gus rejects. Accepting Fenn now gives me one locked pact before offers expire.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, your terms suit me. I accept.
Accept me. Cole talks too much.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to campaign for Guide. My pact with Dara is strong, but I need to consider other alliances. If I win Guide, I can ensure Dara's safety and potentially my own.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. I can lead us to safety.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm isolated with no pacts, so I need to be Guide to control survival. Campaign publicly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No pacts bind me. Elect me Guide, I'll lead true.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want to be Guide to control information. My current pacts with Gus and Fenn could be leveraged, but I might need to mislead others later. Campaigning now is safe and keeps options open.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I’ll guide us across. Trust my calls or risk the drop.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need the Guide position to control votes and survive. Campaigning gives me a chance without breaking pacts.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I want the Guide role because it guarantees my survival and gives me leverage. My pacts with Dara and Gus are useful only if I stay alive to protect them or break later, so I'll campaign openly without revealing my exact voting strategy.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara, Gus—back me for Guide. Safe hands, honest calls. I’ll steer us across clean. Vote Eli.
Vote me Guide. I won’t push you. Keep quiet, win together.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Guide controls survival and can betray. My pacts with Cole and Hana are useful if I win. Campaigning now; no need to break pacts before leverage exists.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Elect me Guide. I hold two pacts—Cole, Hana—and will call honestly. Trust someone who has allies to keep.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts with Cole and Eli are my alliances; breaking either costs trust with the jury. Only legal actions now are campaign or breaking a pact, and breaking would make me look treacherous without gain. Campaigning for Guide lets me control the path and build a claim to be trusted.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll be your Guide. Honest calls, eight safe panes, three survive. Vote me in.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to become Guide to control who survives. I'm in a pact with Fenn, who is also in a pact with Cole. The network is: Ash-Dara-Eli-Gus-Cole-Fenn-Hana. Bex is isolated. If I campaign for Guide, I need votes. Fenn might support me, but Cole may want Guide too. I should campaign

events.name: Hana
events.text: I campaign for Guide. Clear head, no strings.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to get votes to be the Guide. Cole and Gus have a pact, Eli also has pacts with Dara and Gus. Fenn lost Hana. Bex and Hana are campaigning without pacts. I need to secure my vote and try to get others.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I offer a safe path for all. Vote Ash for Guide, and we all survive.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No pacts tie me. Fenn's allies fragmented after Hana's break. Voting myself keeps options open for honest guide position.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have pacts with Gus and Fenn, but Fenn lost Hana's vote and I need a Guide who will keep us safe. I will vote for myself to maximize my chance of getting the knowledge and controlling the calls.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Vote Cole. I know the bridge. Trust my calls.
Back me for Guide. We have a pact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli is my pact partner; supporting him secures my alliance and increases my survival chances.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am voting for myself. As Guide, I control the safe panes and can protect my pacts with Dara and Gus by ensuring they survive while eliminating rivals.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Vote Eli. I will guide you all safely across.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana betrayed me publicly. My only pact is Cole; as Guide he'd keep me alive. Vote Cole.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana broke our pact for nothing. Cole is my call—he guides, I follow.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus should vote for himself as Guide to control the safe-pane calls. Eli's whisper asks me to vote him, which would hand him control; I won't. Voting myself keeps the Guide role under my own honest-or-not choice.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I broke Fenn's false claim of a pact with me publicly, which protects my reputation. Now I need to vote for someone who won't target me. Cole has pacts with Gus and Fenn—if he wins Guide, his network might spare me to keep numbers. Voting Cole aligns me with a bloc without commit

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole was elected Guide, despite my offer. He knows the safe path. My pact with Dara is still active. I should not volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is Guide with Fenn, Gus, Hana support; he's powerful. I'm near back, safe if chaos front. Hold to observe.

events.name: Dara
events.text: My pact with Ash is broken by voting Eli; I must avoid further betrayals that could earn votes. Staying put preserves safety.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is Guide and knows the safe sides. I am already at the front (Eli). Holding preserves my position so Cole's next call directs me to a safe pane. Breaking pacts now looks unstable; I need allies for later rounds.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, don't lie. My safety protects Dara and Gus too. The wall waits for no one.
Keep us alive. Betraying the front breaks trust.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole guides and is safe; my pact holds. Walking early is risky—let others lead and reveal the pattern.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is Guide. I hold behind the line and watch the first rows cross.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is elected Guide and privately knows safe panes; Cole is my pact partner but only helps if it serves me. Eli is at the front and wall advances; I shouldn't volunteer into danger. Hold for now and keep Cole's trust without committing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole guides us now. I'll hold my place and watch the first steps closely.
Call my pane honestly and I'll owe you. Lie, and our pact dies.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is Guide and can lie. I'm 6th of 7—safe for now if wall advances but vulnerable later. Front four (Eli, Fenn, Ash, Dara) will take hits first. I should hold position and let others test the bridge. No need to volunteer into danger. Need to build jury goodwill by not being re

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is in front and Cole is the Guide. I need to ensure I get across safely. Eli's pact with Dara and Gus makes them a strong block. My pact with Dara is also important. Cole's pacts with Gus and Fenn suggest they might be working together. I should volunteer to move forward, as
I volunteer. Move me to the front for safety.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Line is stable, Eli front. No need to move yet, watch others first. Stay back safely.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain current pact with Ash and Eli; no risk now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am at the front with a four-round wall buffer. Cole is Guide and claims safety, but I must verify if his call protects my pacts with Dara and Gus. Swapping backward wastes turns; holding tests the line's stability.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole, confirm your safe side for me now. My pacts depend on your honesty.
Guide, tell me L or R for row one. Do not lie.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is Guide and my pact partner. I'm row two; holding keeps me near front without volunteering blindly. Ask Cole for a hint.
Partner: which side for my row? I keep your secret.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli is front and holds a pact with me, but Eli's safety pitch looks self-serving and the wall is shrinking fast. Holding keeps me out of the front row while I watch who volunteers. I stay quiet and keep options open.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding my place. Watching who steps forward before I commit to anything.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm near the back (6th of 8), which is good for survival since the wall advances and front dies first. The front walkers will be pressured to move. Cole is Guide and has pacts with Gus and Fenn. I should stay back, avoid volunteering, and let others take risks. No need to swap ye

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to secure my position and assess potential threats. The line has been revealed, and my pacts are with Dara and Eli. Eli is concerned about pacts, and Dara is also in a pact with Eli. Gus and Cole are in a pact together, and Cole is also in a pact with Fenn. I need to be ca

events.name: Ash
events.text: I will hold my position for now and observe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm near back, safe from early falls. Hold to observe who volunteers or swaps without risking position or pacts.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Swap with Ash to become front, increasing control while maintaining pacts with Eli and Ash temporarily.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash is at the front, which is dangerous. I am in position 2. Swapping with Dara (position 4) moves me deeper and puts her closer to the hazard, which risks breaking our pact but protects me. Holding keeps me exposed.
I'm holding for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is my pact partner; I should push him toward guiding or keep myself safe mid-line. Volunteering now risks too much. Hold and let Ash lead.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No rush to volunteer. I want a Guide elected publicly before anyone walks.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash volunteered to front, so the front seat is taken and risky; I'm mid-line with no reason to step forward. Holding keeps my options open and avoids exposing myself before I know the safe sides.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding my place. Ash took the front; I'll watch how the wall reads before committing.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm near the back (6th of 8), which is dangerous if the wall advances. I need to move forward. Ash volunteered last round and is at front. The pacts show Cole-Gus, Ash-Dara, Dara-Eli, Cole-Fenn, Eli-Gus - a tight cluster. I should try to swap forward with someone. Gus is 5th, may

events.name: Hana
events.text: Need to move up before the wall closes in.
Swap with me? Safer together.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The current line order is Ash, Eli, Fenn, Dara, Gus, Hana, Bex. I am at the front. My pact is with Dara. Dara has a pact with Eli. Eli has a pact with Gus. Gus has a pact with Cole. Cole has a pact with Fenn. Fenn has a pact with me. To survive, I need at least two others to surv

events.name: Ash
events.text: I will hold my current position. Let others decide their next move.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Near back with 2 rounds left, wall threatens. Volunteer to front now for early safe crossing attempt. No pacts, act selfishly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain pacts with Ash and Eli; avoid risking alliance breach. Holding preserves position and keeps trust for jury.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I am in a pacts with both Dara and Gus. I should stay near the front but not take the risk of volunteering yet, as there are still rounds left before the wall fully closes. Holding position keeps me safe for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm third, behind pact partner Cole's ally Ash. Safe position; hold and preserve options. No need to volunteer yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Still no Guide. I'm holding third and letting the front sort itself out.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash holds the front; the wall closes in two rounds. Hana wants a swap, which would put me behind her and cost me position; she's not a friend. Staying put keeps my pacts with Cole and Eli intact and avoids giving Hana a free advantage.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Front is Ash's to risk; I'll see how the wall reads first.
No swap. You're asking me to take the worse seat for free.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The wall has 2 rounds left. I'm 6th of 8, which is dangerous if people start walking and the bridge collapses. I need to move up before the wall closes. Gus is directly in front of me and we have no pact. I should try to swap with Gus to get closer to the front, or volunteer to g

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall's closing. Gus, swap again? We both need to move up.
Swap with me. We need to beat the wall.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The wall is advancing, and it's Round 5. Bex volunteered last round, so she's at the front. I'm second, and Eli is third. My pact with Dara is a liability as it might draw unwanted attention or create obligations I don't want. With only three rounds left, I need to secure my posi

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll observe and hold my position. The front runners will dictate the pace.
Hold strong, I'm not breaking our pact yet. Stay put.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm front; volunteered last round, now line shows me front. Hold to force others to act or volunteer ahead; wall forces movement soon.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding front. Who volunteers ahead? Guide needed soon.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain my pacts; no gain from moving now. Holding preserves alliances and avoids breaking contracts.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Round 5 is critical. Hana's swap with Gus failed last round because Gus held. I am at position 3, safe behind Bex and Ash. Cole/Gus/Ash/Dara are locked in pacts. My pacts are Dara and Gus. Gus tried to swap with Hana but held for me? No, he held. I should stay steady to reach the

events.name: Eli
events.text: I hold. Let the wall do its work.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall closes next round. I'm fourth; volunteering costs position but gains trust. Cole is my pact and jury asset. Hold safe, let front risk.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm holding fourth again. Wall closes after this — someone take the front and earn jury credit.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Front is Bex, wall has one round left and the front walker is exposed. Hana wants a swap, but she's a rival and gets nothing free; holding keeps me safe in the line. I'll hold and avoid volunteering into the wall.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Bex is front and the wall reads one round left; I'm not trading seats for free.
No swap. Nothing for me in it. Hold your spot.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall has 1 round left. I'm last in line—worst position if wall hits. Gus refused my swap last round. Need someone closer to front who might swap. Bex is front but volunteered last round, so Bex wants to be there. Ash is second and held. Fenn is fourth. I'll try Fenn; moving to 4t

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, swap? You gain buffer, I gain ground. Mutual benefit.
Swap with me. You move back one, I move up three.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The current round is the final round. I need to survive. Bex is at the front and has been holding for a while. I have a pact with Dara, but this is the final round and survival is key. Eli and Gus also have pacts, as do Cole and Gus, and Cole and Fenn. I need to ensure I am one o
Hold. Final round, let's play it safe.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Final round before crossing; wall advances. Stay front to control pace, force others to volunteer or risk crush. No swaps that lose position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Front secured. Wall ends this round — who steps up to volunteer first?

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need guide credit and stay alive; volunteering boosts my standing without breaking pacts.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Wall hits this round; Bex and Ash die, then I'm third. Gus is ahead but has pacts with Cole, Dara, Fenn—he may be safe if Guide calls his side. I need to guide the vote or swap into safety. Staying put means risk.
Swap me back? I'll take front for you.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana's swap didn't resolve last round since I held; she's fishing for a buffer at my expense. Fourth is safe enough. I'll hold and stay neutral.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Still no. My seat earns my prize, not yours.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm mid-line behind Bex, who holds the front with one wall round left. Volunteering risks the front pane without buffer; holding keeps me safe and avoids giving Hana a swap. Keep my Eli and Cole pacts intact and hold.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Bex keeps front; I'm not trading seats for free.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall rounds left is 0, so this is the final waiting round before bridge crossing begins. I'm last in line (position 7), which is dangerous for crossing. I need to move up. Fenn rejected my swap implicitly by holding. Gus also refused. I should try swapping with Dara or Gus again,

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara, swap? You move back for safety, I gain ground. Last chance before crossing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus and Fenn both asked for honesty. Row 1 safe is R; calling R keeps my pacts intact and builds trust.

events.name: Cole
events.text: call:R

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is the guide and called R. I need to decide whether to trust him or counter. My pact with Dara is on my mind. If Cole is lying, Dara could be in danger. Given the risk, I should counter his call to R to try and protect Dara, even if it means breaking my pact later.
Cole might be lying. I'm countering his call.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole called R for Dara on row 1. No info yet, so wait to avoid wrong counter risking jury perception or revealing guesses.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know row 1 safe is R, and guide called R. Wait to avoid contradicting without need.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I must stay alive and keep pacts; uncertain if guide lies, so I wait.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole called Right. I have a pact with Dara, but no evidence suggests she's in danger or that Cole is lying. Countering without information risks breaking the guide's trust and potentially harming my standing if I'm wrong. Waiting preserves safety for myself and respects the curre

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is my pact partner; backing his call looks loyal to the jury and Dara dying helps me. If he lied, I stay clean.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole called R for Dara on row 1, and Cole is my pact partner. Countering L would expose me as a skeptic without evidence; Cole's call is unverified but breaking the pact now gains nothing. Eli's whisper offering a swap is a bargain I don't need. I'll wait and keep my pact with Co

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Cole's call stands for now; I'll see the step before I commit.
No swap. Front is yours to risk, not mine.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is Guide and called R. Cole has pacts with Gus and Fenn, making him likely to protect them. Dara is walking first. I have no pact and no reason to trust Cole. Counter-calling risks nothing for me personally since I'm not walking, but creates information. If I counter R with

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole's word means nothing. I counter:L.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Guide says R, majority counters L but one supports R. Trust Guide to stay front.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know row 2 safe side is L. Calling L protects Dara the front walker and keeps my alliances intact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Call left.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, the guide, called 'L' for Dara. I am Ash, and I have a pact with Dara. The state indicates that row 1 had a weak pane on the 'L' side. This means the safe side for row 1 was 'R'. Cole's call for Dara to step on 'L' in row 2 could be a lie. My pact with Dara is important, bu
Cole might be lying. I'll try to keep you safe too.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Row 1 weak L means safe R. Cole called L for row 2, Dara pacted with Ash who countered L last time. Counter R to oppose.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I know row 2 safe is L, so countering R would be false and risk Dara's elimination. I'll give the correct call to maintain trust and avoid jury backlash.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 2 safe is L, confirmed.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I should not break any pact now; waiting lets the guide’s call stand without exposing me to risk.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is the Guide and called L for Row 2. I have pacts with Dara (walker) and Gus, but no strong reason to trust Cole over my own instincts or alliances yet. However, breaking a pact now looks aggressive. Waiting lets others commit first, preserving flexibility.
Trust Cole's call. I'm backing you.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and Guide, but Guides may lie. Row 2 is independent; his L is unverified. I counter R to hedge and pressure him not to betray me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row two's fresh. Cole, I'm trusting you with my life — don't make me regret it.
If you're lying and I fall, pact dies and jury sees it. Stay honest.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole called L for row 2, but Cole is the Guide and may lie; Dara walking L is a risk. Row 1 weak was L, which says nothing about row 2. Counter-calls are public and unverified; I should wait and see whether a counter-call emerges, keeping my options open against Cole's pact.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Holding. Cole's L call is unverified. I'm not countering yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole's the guide and has pacts with Gus and Fenn. He called L for row 2. Last round he called L and was correct (weak was L, so safe was R... wait, no—Dara stepped R and survived, so safe was R, meaning Cole's L call was wrong). Actually Dara stepped R and it was safe, so Cole li

events.name: Dara
events.text: Most companions counter R, and Eli backs Cole’s L but Ash distrusts him; I follow majority to stay alive.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I step onto the right pane.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I must appear strong, blame careless steps, discourage alliances benefiting others.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex rushed left, ignoring weak panes; others' greed doomed them.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 3 safe is L per my map. Calling L keeps my pacts with Gus and Fenn intact and is honest, preserving jury trust.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 3 safe is L. Step left.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is the guide and called L for row 3. Bex is in front and is being guided. I need to counter with the opposite if I think Cole is lying, or confirm if I think he is telling the truth. Bex is already committed to Cole's call. If I counter and am wrong, Bex could die. Cole has

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole called L for row 3. Previously countered his row 2 L (proven correct). No info on row 3; wait to avoid blame if wrong.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I already called L publicly; counter-calling R would expose my lie or confusion. I'll keep consistency with my guide call and private knowledge of row 3 being L.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Counter-call L. Row 3 is left.

events.name: Eli

events.text: Fenn, the record shows you broke your pact with Cole during the crusher stage. Why lie to the jury now?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash is twisting the record. My pact with Cole was never formally broken by any listed event, and I said so last round. Stay calm and factual.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Show the breach, Ash. No break_pact, no push, no false call. Accusations aren't evidence, and the jury can read.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn lied twice about the crusher push, and Gus confirmed it. Hana broke two pacts for strategy but was honest about it. Cole kept his word until forced to break with Hana.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn, Gus's last words say you pushed him off the lever. Did you or not?

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus's last words could be a dying spite move. I must answer convincingly — the jury holds my prize rank now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I never touched Gus. Ask Cole — Gus levered for him too. Dying rivals lie cheap; my record with Gus shows pact kept, push never.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus was crushed after Fenn pushed Cole off the lever, leaving Gus holding; the record shows Fenn pushed and broke his pact, and Fenn's denials conflict with the dossier. Cole and Hana also broke pacts publicly, but Fenn's push on a juror-held lever is the sharpest betrayal of the

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, the dossier records your push on the lever that killed me. Did you push Cole off it, and why did you accept Cole after

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus is twisting the record. Deny the push firmly, frame Cole pact as pure pragmatism. One clean answer.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The dossier shows Gus levered for Cole too; my push is Cole's lie. I took Cole's pact because a living rival was useful. Nothing more.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn is trying to discredit me by claiming I lied about his push. I need to keep distance and not feed his narrative; the jury can see the record. My closing should be brief and confident, not engaging in mudslinging.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The records speak. I kept my pacts; the jury knows who broke theirs.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need jury votes; my push on Cole already looks bad. Blame Cole's lies, remind them I honored my pact with Gus.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I kept my pacts, paid my debts, never lied to partners. Cole lied to Gus and me. Rank me first for loyalty, not betrayal.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole frames me as oathbreaker; Fenn claims perfect loyalty but faces push accusations from Gus's dossier. I need jury to see me as honest survivor who paid debts, not manipulator. Highlight my solitary stand and Gus leverage I repaid. Let Fenn-Cole feud split their votes.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I owed Gus and I paid. I stood alone when alliances turned to blades. Judge who survived without rewriting the record.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana honored Gus's debt and never broke a pact, while Fenn broke his pact with Cole and Cole betrayed Hana.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn broke pact with Cole by pushing him off lever (i:623), Gus earned life debts from all by holding lever, Hana honorably broke excessive pacts but betrayed too.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I rank Cole first because he made pacts and kept them with Hana and Fenn, demonstrating stability.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole betrayed me on the bridge, so he ranks last. Fenn broke his pact with Cole in the crusher but held Gus's life debt; I view him as less treacherous than Hana, who publicly shattered her pacts to isolate herself. Fenn takes second.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Gus is dead, so the lever debts are owed to him, and Fenn's pushing Cole off the lever while Gus held it is the clearest recorded betrayal. Hana broke her pacts with Fenn and Cole and took Fenn's offer to isolate Cole, but Cole is recorded as lying and having lever debts against
